messages.build.test.power.name: Test · Sharpened blade
messages.build.test.power.description: Both actions gain {bonus_percent}% attack damage. Action bonuses add before the final cap; derived damage does not multiply the bonus again.
messages.build.test.agility.name: Test · Fleet foot
messages.build.test.agility.description: Normal movement speed increases by {bonus_percent}%. Dodge speed stays unchanged.
messages.build.test.wave.name: Test · Sword wave
messages.build.test.wave.description: Each attack releases a wave, even on a miss. It deals {damage_percent}% of that attack's damage and stops on a wall or enemy.
messages.build.test.chain.name: Test · Echo chain
messages.build.test.chain.description: A melee or wave hit chains to up to {jumps} other enemies within {radius_m} m. It starts at {damage_percent}% of damage dealt, retaining {falloff_percent}% each hop. Once per cast.
messages.build.test.split.name: Test · Projectile split
messages.build.test.split.description: This action’s projectiles split on contact into {count} children for {damage_percent}% parent damage, up to {max_generation} generation. Excludes Pierce and Frost Blast on this action.

messages.settings.title: Settings
messages.settings.session_note: Changes apply now · Settings are not saved yet
messages.settings.exit_warning: Quitting discards unsaved training or preview progress. Game saving is not available yet. Quit anyway?
messages.settings.save_note: Game saving and loading are not connected yet. This page reserves space for slots and progress. No game saves are available.
messages.build.test.arrow_hint: T fires an isolated debug arrow. It does not inherit or unlock left/right action upgrades.
messages.build.test.blast.name: Test · Impact blast
messages.build.test.blast.description: This action’s contacts create a {radius_m} m blast for {damage_percent}% attack damage with radial falloff. Excludes the direct target and walls. Each projectile blasts on its first contact only.
messages.build.test.contact_slow.name: Test · Contact slow
messages.build.test.contact_slow.description: Melee and projectile contacts slow movement by {slow_percent}% for {duration_sec} s; reapply keeps the longer remaining duration.
messages.build.test.contact_freeze.name: Test · Contact freeze
messages.build.test.contact_freeze.description: This action’s direct contacts freeze enemies for {duration_sec}s, up to {max_per_root} targets per cast. Freeze cannot refresh; thaw grants brief shared immunity.
messages.build.test.freeze_duration.name: Test · Longer freeze
messages.build.test.freeze_duration.description: This action’s future freeze effects gain {bonus_percent}% duration, bounded by the status duration cap. Another action’s freeze cannot satisfy its requirement.
messages.build.test.mechanism_hint: LMB: combo · RMB: special · T: isolated debug arrow · Cyan: frost
messages.build.pierce.name: Piercing
messages.build.pierce.description: This action’s linear projectiles hit up to {max_hits} distinct enemies. An equipped blast triggers only on the first contact. Excludes Split on this action.
messages.build.frost_blast.name: Frost Blast
messages.build.frost_blast.description: This action’s compatible blast freezes up to {max_targets} enemies for {duration_sec}s, including a surviving direct target. Shared freeze immunity applies.
messages.build.preset.title: Action build presets
messages.build.preset.hint: Presets replace your build but keep enemies. LMB: combo; RMB: special. Retry resets the arena and build.
messages.build.preset.error: Preset unavailable. Retry training and try again.

messages.build.sword_wave_form.name: Sword-wave form
messages.build.sword_wave_form.description: Replaces this action’s melee slash with a sword wave. Fires even on a miss; performs no melee strike.
messages.build.sword_heavy_form.name: Heavy-slash form
messages.build.sword_heavy_form.description: Restores this action’s close-range heavy slash. Replaces the sword-wave form.
messages.build.action_power.name: Focused edge
messages.build.action_power.description: This action gains {bonus_percent}% attack damage. It adds to global damage bonuses before the final cap.
